attributes.residual: STACK_LAYOUT, now localised to EXACTLY 4 BYTES and no longer a mystery. Measured layout model: an added u8[8] moves the frame 56 -> 64, so this frame IS source-responsive (the prior park's contrary conclusion is refuted). Reaching the target frame 48 needs the requirement in 41..48, i.e. exactly 4 more bytes.
